# Zolius Vault

> Self-Custodial Confidential Vault & Transfers on Solana Privacy Rings
> Protocol: Solana Privacy Rings (ML-KEM-768 + Groth16 zk-SNARKs)
> Network: Solana Mainnet-Beta
> App: https://zolius.com/app
> Twitter / X: https://x.com/ZoliusVault

## Overview
Zolius Vault is a self-custodial privacy workstation on Solana:
- **Deposit & Shield**: Blind public SOL and SPL tokens into the Solana Privacy Program. State updates in a 26-level LeanIMT Poseidon Merkle tree.
- **Confidential ZK Swap**: Exchange shielded assets via Cross-Program Invocation (CPI) to DEX liquidity without exposing transaction amounts on-chain.
- **Confidential Timelock Escrow**: Time-locked confidential transfers and vesting with deterministic clock release and sender revocation controls.
- **Decoupled Unshielding / Withdraw**: Client-side Groth16 witness generation breaks all linkability to deposit history upon withdrawal to fresh recipient addresses.
- **Quantum-Ready Viewing Keys**: Off-chain viewing keys, memos, and vault backups derived deterministically (ZOLIUS/vault/v1) and encrypted with ML-KEM-768 (X-Wing hybrid lattice encryption).

## Key Technical Specifications
- **On-Chain ZK Proof System**: Groth16 SNARKs over BN254 with Poseidon hashing on Solana SVM.
- **Off-Chain Post-Quantum Suite**: ML-KEM-768 (FIPS 203) combined with X25519 (X-Wing KEM) + XChaCha20-Poly1305.
- **Solana Privacy Program**: ring1GaLCuJnkUMVkX2JeZLTTX17wKsV4fZmPVzXANW (Audited by Certora, OtterSec, and zkSecurity).
- **Zolius Swap Program**: zolSwap111111111111111111111111111111111111 (solana-verify reproducible build).
- **Zolius Lock Program**: zolLock111111111111111111111111111111111111 (solana-verify reproducible build).
- **Execution Environment**: Solana Mainnet-Beta.
